Asha (Support): Riley flagged a behavior change after this morning's model rollout — they say responses are "colder" / less friendly. Riley pasted a before/after.

Riley (Customer): Yep — before update (v9b) our assistant replied: "Happy to help! I can walk you through that step by step." After (v9c): "I will provide the steps." Feels blunt, losing small niceties we relied on. :frowning:

Asha (Support): Can you paste the exact request payload + model id? Any system prompt changes on your side?

Riley (Customer): No system prompt changes from us. Sending minimal reproducer below.

Riley (Customer): ```
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-v9c",
  "input": "How do I reset my API key?",
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "max_tokens": 120
}
```

Riley (Customer): Full responses:

Before (redwood-v9b):
"Happy to help! To reset your API key, go to Settings > API keys, click rotate... Let me know if you want me to walk through screenshots."

After (redwood-v9c):
"To reset your API key, go to Settings > API keys and click rotate."

Riley (Customer): It's a subtle cadence drop but our UX relies on soft language.
